verdict.rationale: Poly is a SaaS file platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question, but the OpenAPI probe found every candidate path (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returning 404. No documentation mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The OAuth-gated MCP server and the CLI are separate integration surfaces, not a downloadable API specification.
